findings.title: Renamed function without updating call sites
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but the new name does not match the local convention of using `read` for sensor accessors (e.g., `readSensor` in the old version). The rename introduces inconsistency with the existing codebase pattern.

summary.problem: The renamed function `sampleSensor` breaks the local naming convention for sensor accessors.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
